paragraphs.text: An agentic roleplay bundle for DeepSeek Harness
# DSH Agentic Roleplay
Persistent, agent-driven roleplay for DeepSeek Harness. Create a world, choose who to play, and ente
r an evolving story whose characters can make decisions of their own.
Instead of treating roleplay as one long prompt, the bundle separates the game master, character dec
isions, record keeping, world authoring, and media work. The story keeps structured state for what h
appened, what each character perceived and remembers, where people and things are, how relationships
change, and which possibilities remain open.
## What makes it different
- Characters act from their own goals, relationships, knowledge, memories, and current situation rat

her than everything stored in the world.
- Plots provide direction and pressure without fixing the o

utcome. Player choices and autonomous character actions determine what happens.
- Worlds are filesys
tem-first and sessions use SQLite. Checkpoints, branching, readable transcripts, and restorable arch

ives preserve the story without rebuilding its setting.
- Optional rclone-based sync moves worlds, s
tories, prompts, and other shared content between devices. Conflicts are kept for review instead of

silently overwriting either copy.
- World creation stays inside DSH. The editor, approval-based auth
oring assistant, recoverable card import, card updates, and isolated playtests cover the path from s

ource material to a playable world.
- Media remains optional. Text play does not require image, spee
ch, embedding, or reranking services; providers add portraits, voiced scenes, voice input, and riche
ding, or reranking services; providers add portraits, voiced scenes, voice input, and richer recall.
The bundle includes a complete roleplay interface, a bounded game-master loop, autonomous character
and faction activity, story-time memory, relationships and knowledge, locations and items, plots, tr
iggers and world-defined commands, reusable avatars, world authoring, speech, and image workflows.
This project is independently maintained by Firefox2100. It is not an official DeepSeek Harness proj
